newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-STURM GRAZ KEEP AUSTRIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STURM GRAZ KEEP AUSTRIAN CUP.

text.p: Sturm Graz retained the Austrian Cup they lifted for the first time last year with a 2-1 victory over second division FC Vienna on Tuesday.
Captain Ivica Vastic scored with a fifth minute penalty and Jens Dowe added a second in the 74th minute from a pass by Wolfgang Hopfer.
Vienna were handed a goal when Mario Posch fired into his own net three minutes from time.
